facts.text: What has become of the shipments to Brandonsford? Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue, and others say nothing has come into town for months.

classification.grounding_justification: Several townsfolk independently reported shipments not arriving, and this Session the narration again notes the shipments still haven't come in.
classification.investigative_depth_justification: The answer would reveal a hidden cause behind a town-wide supply failure lasting months, possibly tied to other troubles.
classification.narrative_payoff_justification: Explaining why the town has been cut off would change the party's understanding of Brandonsford's troubles.
classification.investigative_potential_justification: It supports questioning townsfolk and following the supply route out of town.
